items.title: Deduction and static equivalence are decidable for separate measure-invariant equational theories
items.author: Raja O. P. Damanik; Alwen Tiu
items.source_version: FSCD2026 LIPIcs378 article14, official CC BY4.0 publisher PDF; Theorem19 and complete AppendicesA/B author proof continuation, with MI deduction15 and required section2/3 definitions
items.difficulty_reason: The author constructs an extended finite subterm saturation, accompanies each saturated term with a recipe, completes the frame, and proves that a bounded characteristic equality set controls arbitrary recipes by a weight-based induction and substitution factorisation. Combining the finite basis with full MI deduction decidability yields both knowledge decisions. All author finite-construction and induction calculations are retained, supporting H2; the short theorem statement is not counted separately from its construction.
